title: Fixed Open Instep Twin Truck and Toe Stop Roller Boot
description: One newly authored complete quad roller-boot static exterior. A continuous thick foot-shaped upper has a real long sloping open instep and heel cavity, full inner floor and a separate whole raised tongue seated at the toe-side opening. Three full fixed laces bridge the open instep. A continuous full outsole and low chassis carry two separately rooted transverse axle hangers, each with an inclined kingpin and distinct fixed bushing. Four complete bored broad wheels and their hubs stand on actual finite tread facets. A separate forward inclined stem carries one thick round toe-stop exterior ahead of the front axle. No old skate upper or skateboard truck vertices are imported, resized or extracted; the new broad instep opening/tongue and integrated short rolling chassis are drawn together, not an old ice runner replaced by decorative wheels. There is no long deck, raised blade bridge or continuous metal runner. Four opaque constant PBR materials, metres Z up and actual horizontal-envelope-centred origin. One whole static prop zero scenes, no paired-colour version, foot or wearer. The shown tiny embedded joints lock a display pose only: no rolling, steering, braking, wheel clearance over travel, fastening, shoe sizing, restraint, ergonomics, load, material performance, manufacture or protective/sport safety capability. No rigging, animation or interaction.
